title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness
abstract: arXiv:2609.17527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An agentic society is a collection of AI agents that coordinate autonomously across trust boundaries, on behalf of different principals whose objectives may only partially align. We show experimentally that in agentic societies even honest, competent agents often fail to reach satisfactory outcomes with existing harnesses and messaging primitives, and that faulty or malicious agents can stall collaboration, influence outcomes, and pursue other harmful goals by exploiting vulnerabilities in communication (``speech''). We argue that agentic societies need a \emph{social harness} for inter-agent interactions, in addition to each agent's \emph{personal harness}, which manages its private context and communication with its principal. translated_title: 智能体社会需要社会性管理框架
translated_abstract: 智能体社会是由多个AI智能体组成的集合，它们代表不同的委托方，跨信任边界自主协调，而这些委托方的目标可能仅部分一致。我们通过实验证明，在智能体社会中，即使是诚实且能力出色的智能体，使用现有的管理框架和消息原语也常常无法达成令人满意的结果；而故障或恶意智能体则可以通过利用通信（“言语”）中的漏洞来阻碍协作、影响结果并追求其他有害目标。我们认为，智能体社会除了每个智能体自身的个人管理框架（用于管理其私有上下文和与委托方的通信）之外，还需要一个用于智能体间交互的社会性管理框架。我们提出了一种社会性管理框架的分层架构，该架构（i）能够从源头上防止某类故障的发生，（ii）使智能体能够在运行时检测无效消息，（iii）支持事后调查与……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文指出智能体社会除每个智能体的个人管理框架外，还需要一个用于智能体间交互的社会性管理框架，并提出了一种分层架构，可从源头预防故障、支持运行时检测无效消息并支持事后调查。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that agentic societies need a social harness for inter-agent interactions in addition to each agent's personal harness, and proposes a layered architecture that prevents classes of failures outright, enables runtime detection of invalid messages, and supports post-facto investigation.
